summary: Retest of the iteration_50 RSVP targeting bug fix. Backend: re-ran the full 19-case regression suite (/app/backend/tests/test_iter50_templates.py) — 19/19 PASS, including the previously failing bug-repro test_alliance_scoped_event_targets_members. Added a new 5-case suite (/app/backend/tests/test_iter51_rsvp_targeting.py) covering all four claimed fixes — 5/5 PASS: GOW-scoped event 'L2' now returns target_count=9 (unscoped=10), alliance_scope='all' behaves as no filter (10), an event scoped to a non-existent alliance returns 0 targets AND leaves send_count=0 / last_sent_at=null, and notification_prefs.reminder=False on admin drops target_count 10 -> 9 (opt-out honoured, prefs restored afterwards). Frontend: UI smoke on /sablonlar -> RSVP Hatırlatma — create template, open 'Katılmayanlara Gönder', picker populated with 8 events, picked GOW event L2, send succeeded and the row badge updated to '1 gönderim' (proof target_count>0 through the UI), then deleted the template. Zero console errors — the previous '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning is gone. Hint banner computed style verified: color rgb(186,230,253) on rgba(56,189,248,0.10), padding 12px, font-size 12px — contrast fix confirmed. All test data cleaned up (rsvp_templates=0, no TEST_ events, event_templates=[T1] preserved).

minor.issue: Push branch (pywebpush + lazy `_get_or_create_vapid`) and the telegram_dm branch remain UNTESTED code paths — db.push_subscriptions is empty and no member has telegram_chat_id in this environment, so push_sent/telegram_sent are always 0.

Candidate query is now `db.users.find({})` with no active/disabled filter at all (the old `is_active: {$ne: False}` guard was dropped). Harmless today (users docs have no is_active field) but any future soft-disable flag will be silently ignored.
Still returns HTTP 200 instead of 201 on creation (pre-existing, cosmetic).

integration_issues.issue: MINOR: the event <select> is rendered empty (only the 'Etkinlik seç…' placeholder) for the first ~1-2s while the SWR /events?archived=false request is in flight, with no loading/skeleton state. A fast admin sees an apparently empty event list. Submit is correctly disabled meanwhile, so no data risk.

action_items: Optional: add a loading state to the RSVP send modal event picker (SWR isLoading) so it doesn't briefly look empty.
Optional: seed one push_subscription and one member.telegram_chat_id in a scratch DB to cover the untested push/telegram fanout branches.

Optional cleanup in rsvp_templates.py send_tpl: the member_ids loop (lines ~158-166) adds u['member_id'] inside the member_ids loop AND again after it — redundant/confusing though functionally correct.
critical_code_review_comments: send_tpl now loads the ENTIRE users collection plus up to 50k member docs on every send (`.to_list(10000)` / `.to_list(50000)`), instead of a targeted query. Fine at 10 users / 255 members, but it is an O(all-users) scan per click — consider querying members by alliance first and reverse-mapping to users when a scope is set.

The opt-out block swallows every exception (`except Exception: pass`) around `from server import _users_disabled_for_pref`; if that import ever breaks, opt-outs are silently ignored with no log line. Log a warning at minimum.
Push fanout logic is still duplicated between server.py and routes/rsvp_templates.py (payload build, VAPID claims, 404/410 subscription cleanup) — extract a shared send_push_to_users() helper.
Templates.jsx is 824 lines with 3 sections + 4 modals; still worth splitting into pages/templates/*.

Regression suites: /app/backend/tests/test_iter50_templates.py (19 cases) + /app/backend/tests/test_iter51_rsvp_targeting.py (5 cases) — both self-cleaning; run the iter51 file with `-n 0` because pytest.ini forces xdist loadscope and the module-scoped fixtures need serial execution. rca_of_the_issue: Previous root cause (users.alliance_name / users.telegram_chat_id do not exist; alliance + chat id live on db.members) is resolved: send_tpl now builds a user->member_ids map from users.member_ids / users.member_id plus a reverse members.user_id index, batch-fetches those member docs for alliance_name + telegram_chat_id, treats alliance_scope ''/'all' as no filter, subtracts _users_disabled_for_pref('reminder'), and only bumps send_count/last_sent_at when target_ids is non-empty. Verified end-to-end via API (target_count 9 on GOW event 'L2') and via UI ('1 gönderim' badge after sending).
